facility.name: Bright Beginnings Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 145 EVANGELINE DR, VIDOR, TX, 77662

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that infants were sitting in restrictive devices for longer than 15 minutes and they were not eating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing Before Eating or Handling Food: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that a caregiver made a bottle for an infant without washing their hands after changing a child?s diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing Before Eating or Handling Food (26 TAC §746.3415(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that a caregiver did not wash their hands after changing an infant?s diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed (26 TAC §746.3505(a))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that two caregivers can be seen using their phone while in the classroom with children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that an infant was observed sleeping in a Sit Me Up chair for more than an hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Physical Activity including Supervised Tummy Time and Safe, Clean, Uncluttered Area: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that infants are not being directly supervised during tummy time. It can be seen in the video that the infants are placed on the floor, on their tummy, and caregivers walk away from them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Physical Activity including Supervised Tummy Time and Safe, Clean, Uncluttered Area (26 TAC §746.2417(3))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that a caregiver did not sanitize the changing table after changing an infant?s diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting: Based on the information gathered during the DFPS investigation infants were not being held and comforted when upset.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §746.2401(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation, evidence supports a caregiver aggressively grabbing and picking up an infant by both arms resulting in injury that required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that a caregiver did not wash an infant?s hands after their diaper changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that a caregiver placed a jar of heated water on the diaper changing table with a bag of milk to thaw for a bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that a child was placed laying on the floor propped up by a boppy pillow while holding their bottle for feeding time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner (26 TAC §746.2419(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation, evidence supports that a caregiver did not use good judgement or self-control when roughly placing an infant in the Sit Me Up Chair causing unsupported head to hit front part of chair. A caregiver did not use good judgement while picking up pacifiers off of the floor and placing them back into an infant?s mouth without being sanitized. Caregivers did not use good judgement and notify the director, or the parent, when a caregiver admitted to picking up an infant and hearing his arm pop.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths: Based on information gathered during the DFPS investigation evidence supports that a caregiver did not cleanse an infant with an individual cloth or disposable wipe after a soiled diaper was removed during a diaper change:
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Cleanse Child with Individual Cloths (26 TAC §746.3501(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on the information gathered during the DFPS investigation the parent was not notified about an injury to an infant that required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: loose staples and sand were located under and around the diaper changing mat in the two year old room and the 12 to 18 month room. This was corrected at inspection and the mats and tables were cleaned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: In the infant room one Infant Care Instruction sheet for was 4 days past due to be updated. The form was last signed on 7-23-25 and is required to be updated every 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A Review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data from January 22, 2025, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: One bottle was not labeled.  This was corrected at inspection when a label was placed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The Director engaged in conducting a recorded forensic interview of a 3-year old child in which the Director is not properly trained to administer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
